## ⛔ CORRECTION — this card names the wrong second surface, and I repeated the error in my own claim

`domain:spec` @ objectui PM seat, session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`. ⛔ The card body above is **not** edited; the correction sits beside it.

**The card says** the trap sits on `form` / `view:form` (`index.tsx:292`) **and on `object-master-detail-form`'s parent `fields` (`~:430`)**. My claim comment `5604074045` repeated that, and printed `:346` with the label `object-master-detail-form`.

**Measured on `origin/main` `8a388ee76`** — each `fields` registration input attributed to its **nearest preceding `ComponentRegistry.register(` and that call's actual type key**, ⛔ not to a nearby `namespace:` line (my first attempt used the `namespace:` heuristic and got a different, wrong answer — it is not the instrument):

```
registrations:  :226 object-form   :285 form   :337 embeddable-form
                :358 form-analytics   :402 object-master-detail-form   :499 line_items

:232  described (PR #8846)  -> object-form
:292  ⛔ BARE                -> form
:346  ⛔ BARE                -> embeddable-form     ← NOT object-master-detail-form
:430  described             -> object-master-detail-form
```

⇒ **`object-master-detail-form` was never bare.** It has carried *"Which parent fields to show, in order. Ignored when `sections` is given…"* all along. The genuinely undescribed second surface is **`embeddable-form`**.

⭐ The round's dev got this right in its residue note while the card and I had it wrong — it flagged `embeddable-form` at `:346` specifically. Recording that because a card that misnames its own subject sends the next seat to the wrong file.

## Current state after PR #8859 (draft, in CI)

Hunk headers name the targets unambiguously:

```
@@ -289,7 +289,7 @@ ComponentRegistry.register('form', ObjectFormRenderer, {          ← described
@@ -427,7 +427,7 @@ ComponentRegistry.register('object-master-detail-form', …      ← existing description EXTENDED with the vocabulary note
```

Bare `{ name: 'fields', type: 'array' },` count: **main 2 → branch head 1**. Control: 4 `fields` inputs total on the branch head, so the instrument is not matching everything.

| surface | warning (route 1) | description |
|---|---|---|
| `object-form` | ✅ inherits | ✅ PR #8846 |
| `form` | ✅ inherits (literally the same `ObjectFormRenderer`) | ✅ PR #8859 |
| `object-master-detail-form` | ✅ inherits (parent `fields` with no sections falls into the same `SimpleObjectForm` branch — **pinned** by the new `topLevelFieldsWarnCoverage-8847.test.tsx` rendering `MasterDetailForm` directly) | ✅ extended by #8859 |
| **`embeddable-form`** | ✅ inherits (`EmbeddableForm` passes `config.fields` straight into `<ObjectForm>` with no sections) | ⛔ **still bare — this card's remainder** |

⇒ **`Refs`, not `Fixes`, is correct** and the dev's call to leave it open was right. The remainder is **one description string** on `embeddable-form`.

⭐ Note what the coverage measurement bought: route 1's warning was **measured** to reach all four surfaces rather than assumed, and the master-detail path got a render-level pin instead of an argument. ⇒ this card's remaining work is documentation-only, on one line.

⚠️ **Dedup channel was down for the round.** REST `/search/issues` is **403 by policy** for these sessions — verified by this seat just now against two known-true controls: *"This GitHub API path is not available: sessions are bound to their configured repositories."* The dev also reported MCP `search_issues` returning `total_count: 0` against known-true controls. ⇒ it correctly handed the residue up rather than filing blind. ⛔ No duplicate card filed; the residue is recorded **here**, on the card that already owns this trap, which needs no dedup at all.

**The remainder, and it is small on purpose.** PR #8859 closed this card's **warning** half for all four surfaces — measured, and pinned for the master-detail path by a test rendering `MasterDetailForm` directly. What is left is **one description string**.

## Measured on `origin/main`, each entry attributed to its real registered type key

⛔ Not by a nearby `namespace:` line — that heuristic gave me a wrong answer once already on this card (`5604654332`):

```
:226 object-form   :285 form   :337 embeddable-form   :358 form-analytics
:402 object-master-detail-form   :499 line_items

:232  described (#8846)  -> object-form
:292  described (#8859)  -> form
:346  ⛔ BARE            -> embeddable-form            ← the remainder
:430  described (#8859)  -> object-master-detail-form
```

Bare `{ name: 'fields', type: 'array' },` count: **1**. Control: **4** `fields` inputs total, so the matcher is not matching everything.

⚠️ **This card's body names the wrong second surface** — it says `object-master-detail-form`, which was **never bare**. Corrected at `5604654332`. ⛔ Read the correction, not the body.

## Scope — one line

Give `embeddable-form`'s `fields` registration input a `description`, modelled on the two that already have one. It must state that members are **bare field names** (`{ name }` tolerated), and that this is **not** the `sections[].fields` vocabulary, which also accepts the spec `FormFieldSchema` object (identity key `field`) — a shape that resolves to no name here and is silently skipped.

⚠️ `EmbeddableForm` passes `config.fields` straight into `<ObjectForm>` with no sections, so it **already inherits** the runtime warning from PR #8859. **Verify that rather than assuming it** — if the warning does *not* reach this surface, that is a finding worth more than the description, and you should report it before writing prose that claims otherwise.

`Fixes objectstack-ai/objectui#8847` — confirm on your own head that no bare `fields` input remains. Changeset required (`@object-ui/plugin-form` is published; `inputs[].description` is an authoring surface).

⛔ Do not add a `?? f.field` fallback, a second warning, or any behaviour — the card's standing prohibition. **This round is description text only.**
